_source: SRS F-07. Wording lives here only; the form maps each error code from the function to this text (Doc 08 Q26).
full_name_chars: Please use letters only in your name.
mobile_format: Please enter a mobile number like 0300 1234567.
email_format: Please check your email address, e.g. name@gmail.com.
program_required: Please choose a program, or “Not sure yet”.
message_length: Please keep your message under 500 characters.
consent_required: Please tick the box so we can contact you.
qualification_invalid: Please choose your last qualification from the list.
failure: We couldn’t send your enquiry. Please try again, or WhatsApp us at {whatsapp}.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please WhatsApp us at {whatsapp}.
